issue.title: Point Apollo recovery runbook at doctl_login
issue.description: After 18w.f0's apollo/recovery.md lands on tailnet's default branch, update One-time authentication to lead with doctl_login and describe its checks for the eight scopes, No expiry, and Apollo visibility. Keep the scope list and manual doctl auth init fallback, add bare doctl_login to Agent policy, and run prettier --check README.md apollo/recovery.md; do not edit tailnet memory because memory_tailnet was declined.

task_type_fields.proposal: Point Apollo's recovery runbook at doctl_login after apollo/recovery.md lands.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The approved plan cannot edit a runbook file that has not landed from 18w.f0, so the doc change must wait for that prerequisite. The follow-up is limited to the runbook; the reviewer declined the tailnet memory edit.

issue.creation_reason: The approved runbook_pointer branch found that apollo/recovery.md is not present on tailnet origin/main. This follow-up waits for the held 18w.f0 recovery file before making the specified runbook edits.
